description: Bhopal: Aiming to equip students with foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies, the Madhya Pradesh govt will roll out an AI-based learning programme in 500 govt schools across eight districts under Mission Buniyaad. The initiative seeks to build studentsâ digital and technological skills before they enter higher education, with the curriculum for Classes VIII to XII currently being prepared for phased implementation.
